Metadata-Version: 2.1
 Name: poetry
-Version: 1.8.2
+Version: 1.8.3
 Summary: Python dependency management and packaging made easy.
 Home-page: https://python-poetry.org/
 License: MIT

Requires-Dist: installer (>=0.7.0,<0.8.0)
 Requires-Dist: keyring (>=24.0.0,<25.0.0)
 Requires-Dist: packaging (>=23.1)
 Requires-Dist: pexpect (>=4.7.0,<5.0.0)
-Requires-Dist: pkginfo (>=1.9.4,<2.0.0)
+Requires-Dist: pkginfo (>=1.10,<2.0)
 Requires-Dist: platformdirs (>=3.0.0,<5)
 Requires-Dist: poetry-core (==1.9.0)
 Requires-Dist: poetry-plugin-export (>=1.6.0,<2.0.0)

[tool.poetry]
 name = "poetry"
-version = "1.8.2"
+version = "1.8.3"
 description = "Python dependency management and packaging made easy."
 authors = ["Sébastien Eustace <sebastien@eustace.io>"]
 maintainers = [

keyring = "^24.0.0"
 # packaging uses calver, so version is unclamped
 packaging = ">=23.1"
 pexpect = "^4.7.0"
-pkginfo = "^1.9.4"
+pkginfo = "^1.10"
 platformdirs = ">=3.0.0,<5"
 pyproject-hooks = "^1.0.0"
 requests = "^2.26"

src = ["src"]
 target-version = "py38"
 
 [tool.ruff.lint]
-unfixable = [
-    "ERA", # do not autoremove commented out code
-]
 extend-select = [
     "B",   # flake8-bugbear
     "C4",  # flake8-comprehensions

ignore = [
     "B905", # use explicit 'strict=' parameter with 'zip()'
     "N818", #  Exception name should be named with an Error suffix
 ]
+extend-safe-fixes = [
+    "TCH", # move import from and to TYPE_CHECKING blocks
+]
+unfixable = [
+    "ERA", # do not autoremove commented out code
+]
 
 [tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]
 ban-relative-imports = "all"
